subject: adult male boxer, bare torso, red boxing gloves held up in guard, red shorts, dark boxing boots
motion: a quick straight jab with the lead hand, returning to guard
facing: in a three-quarter fighting view facing screen-right
effects: a short white air-cut streak behind the lead glove at full extension

plan.source: Three‑quarter guard facing screen-right: lead (left) foot forward in stagger, weight centered; knees soft; left glove slightly ahead of chin, right glove tight at cheek; elbows in; head looking right; both hands wear boxing gloves.

frames.pose: Anticipation: small dip back; torso leans slightly rearward, weight shifts to rear foot; lead glove retracts near chest, rear glove rises to cheek; elbows tight; head still right; rear foot planted, front heel light.

Strike key: torso drives and twists right; lead arm fully extended straight at target, fist vertical; rear glove tight at cheek; lead foot planted and knee flexed; rear heel pivots up; head tucked behind lead shoulder.
frames.effect: short white air-cut streak trailing behind the extended lead glove along its forward path.

frames.pose: Recoil: torso passes neutral; lead arm snaps halfway back toward guard, elbow low; rear glove shades jaw; weight re-centers; lead foot planted, rear heel lowering; head lifts but faces right.

Settle: torso upright with slight forward lean; lead glove returns close to chin, rear glove firm at cheek; shoulders relax toward start; both feet planted with same stagger, knees soft; weight balanced; head faces right to loop.
